LTTH Version 1.4.2 Release Notes

Stream Monsters 1.12.0 now uses the canonical stream-monsters identity while retaining permanent streamalchemy compatibility.

- CHANGED: Canonical source, manifest, store, dashboard, lifecycle and public routes use stream-monsters
- COMPATIBILITY: Legacy lifecycle, UI, overlay, static, config, data, backup, GCCE and IFTTT aliases resolve to the same logical plugin
- SAFETY: Atomic dual state/config shadows and backup conflict detection fail closed on independent edits
- RECOVERY: Transactional upgrade and authenticated rollback restore files, runtime, state, config and persistent data on failure
- PACKAGE: The historical streamalchemy-1.11.1.zip remains byte-identical with SHA-256 46918c6c52bd0bcae123950e038e4db3feadd30fa1bc514758e8e411d00c3b60
